verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs describe API-driven transactional email for order confirmations, password resets and other automated emails. They also document batch transactional requests with idempotency keys, a sandbox test mode, an SMTP relay, and magic-link delivery (via Supabase Auth SMTP). The same platform runs marketing campaigns, so transactional and marketing sends live together. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of transactional delivery, and explicit documentation that marketing campaigns are sent through the same API surface.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends
